hook: RTX Spark: up to 128 GB memory, 1 PFLOP AI — plus 4

items.claim: Amp lets developers build software using GPT‑6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT‑Live‑1
GitHub says early testing shows Gemini 4 Argon solving more coding tasks than earlier Gemini models on every coding benchmark
Apple HomeView combines smart‑home dashboard, audio, and video on a 7‑inch display
Gemini 4 Argon is built to be an active research partner, DeepMind says
NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute

caption: Developers can now tap GPT‑6 Astra in Amp to speed code creation. Meanwhile, RTX Spark brings massive on‑device AI power. Which upgrade would you try first, RTX or Amp?
alt_text: Slide 1: NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB memory and 1 PFLOP AI compute. Slide 2: Amp lets developers build software using GPT‑6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT‑Live‑1. Slide 3: GitHub says early testing shows Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot solving more coding tasks than earlier Gemini models. Slide 4: Apple HomeView offers a 7‑inch smart‑home display with audio and video. Slide 5: DeepMind says Gemini 4 Argon is built to be an active research partner.
